'''Edible bird's nests''', also known as '''swallow nests''' ({{lang-zh|c=燕窝|p=yànwō}}), are [[bird nest]]s created from solidified [[saliva]] by [[edible-nest swiftlet]]s of various genera ''[[Aerodramus]]'', ''[[Hydrochous]]'', ''[[Schoutedenapus]]'' and ''[[Collocalia]]'', which are harvested for human consumption.
[[File:Edible Bird's Nest Packaged f.jpg|thumb|Edible swiftlet nests, packaged for sale]]
Swiftlet nests have been used as a [[delicacy]] for over 400 years, most often as [[soup]]. They are particularly prized in [[Chinese cuisine]] due to the rarity, high [[protein]] content and rich flavor, and are among the most expensive [[animal product]]s consumed by humans, with prices up to about {{convert|4300|$/lb|$/kg}} depending on grading (based on shape, colour, and species). They are usually white, but there is also a red version that is sometimes called 'blood nest' ({{lang-zh|c=血燕|p=Xuě Yàn}}).
